newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - Feb 27.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - Feb 27.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Thursday:
* On Wednesday, the Dow Jones fell 55.03 points to 6,983.18. The Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange Composite Index of 100 large-capitalisation stocks fell 6.20 points to 1,265.37.
* U.S. Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan voiced concern about soaring stock prices and said the central bank was ready to raise interest rates to ward off inflation.
* Nikkei Stock Average was down 93.83 points at 18,897.09 at 0023 GMT.
* Land & General posted a 60 percent jump in 1996 net profit. It expects a difficult year.
* DCB Holdings reported a 25 percent increase in 1996 net profit.
* Public Bank posted a 23.5 percent rise in 1996 net profit, and proposed bonus and rights issues.
